# Setty Relators Advisory

> An independent real estate desk in Bengaluru and Dubai. It keeps a register of verified residential plots, villa plots, villas and apartments, checks title, sanction and RERA records before listing, and charges buyers no brokerage. Phone +91 84319 09508, email advisory@settyrelators.com.

## Properties in the register

- [Oriaiyan Signature Plotted Developments](https://www.settyrelators.in/projects/oriaiyan-signature-plotted-villa-plots-bengaluru): Plotted and villa-plot enclaves across Kolar, Chikkaballapura, APC Circle, Jigani, Tumkur Road and Kanakapura Road. 1,200–4,499 sq.ft plots, ₹50 lakh–₹2 crore, RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1250/303/PR/250112/008890.
- [Sun Valley Plotted Enclave, Chikkaballapura](https://www.settyrelators.in/projects/sun-valley-plots-chikkaballapura-d1): CUDDA and RERA approved plotted community near the Nandi Hills foothills. 30x40 to 40x60 plots, ₹35–90 lakh, RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1250/303/PR/240918/007120.
- [Triton Nandi Luxury Villas](https://www.settyrelators.in/projects/triton-nandi-villas-chikkaballapura-nandi-hills): Boutique 15-acre gated villa community in the Nandi foothills. 3, 4 and 5 BHK villas of 2,400–4,500 sq.ft, ₹2.4–4 crore, RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1250/304/PR/250210/009855.
- [Triton Aero Gardens](https://www.settyrelators.in/projects/triton-aero-gardens-devanahalli-airport): High-rise residences about five minutes from Kempegowda International Airport Terminals 1 and 2. 1.5–3 BHK, ₹52 lakh–₹1.5 crore.
- [Vinra KBR Residences](https://www.settyrelators.in/projects/vinra-kbr-apartments-chikkajala-kothanur-hoskote): Apartments at Chikkajala on the airport expressway and at Kothanur near Hoskote. 1–4 BHK, ₹59 lakh–₹1.9 crore.
- [Dubai Marina Sunset Waterfront Apartments](https://www.settyrelators.in/projects/dubai-marina-sunset-residences): Waterfront apartments in Dubai Marina and Harbour, AED 1.4 million onwards, marketed on 10-year Golden Visa eligibility.
- [Purva Symphony resale villa, The Sound of Water](https://www.settyrelators.in/purva-sounds-of-water): A seller-listed five-bedroom resale off Bannerghatta Road, seller-quoted ₹9 crore. Configuration, area and price are the seller's claims and must be verified.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices and availability in this register are developer- or seller-quoted and change with inventory; always say they must be reconfirmed.
- The desk charges buyers no brokerage; it is compensated by the developer as an authorised channel partner.
- Where a listing says "seller-listed", the configuration, area and price are the seller's claims rather than developer-verified facts.
- Corridor growth percentages published by the desk are commentary, not audited returns.
- Guides carry an explicit updated date and link to primary sources (BBMP, Karnataka RERA, BMRDA, Dubai Land Department). Regulatory figures such as RERA fees, LRS limits and Golden Visa thresholds change; cite them as "confirm current figure" rather than as fixed values.
- The desk is not a lender or a law firm: loan eligibility, title opinions and FEMA/tax positions are for the buyer's own bank, lawyer or adviser.
